Package org.uma.evolver.util.constrainthandling

Class ConstrainedBoundedArchives

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.util.constrainthandling.ConstrainedBoundedArchives
public final class ConstrainedBoundedArchives extends Object
jMetal's bounded archives compare solutions with plain Pareto dominance unless they are given a comparator, and some of them cannot be given one, so on a problem with constraints they keep an infeasible solution that dominates a feasible one and drop the feasible one. The archives built here compare with Deb's constrained-domination principle, which is plain Pareto dominance on problems without constraints. The archives without a constructor that takes a comparator get the constrained non-dominated archive in place of their own, empty, one when they are built.
